project_type: Full-stack app: React SPA frontend + Python FastAPI backend
test_command: cd frontend && npm test (10 tests), cd backend && pytest tests/ -v (75 tests)
verification_instructions: 1. Run frontend tests: cd frontend && npm test. 2. Run frontend build: cd frontend && npm run build. 3. Run backend tests: cd backend && pytest tests/ -v
setup_instructions: cd frontend && npm install; cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access. Node 22, Python 3.11 pre-installed.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing patterns.
key_patterns: Components in frontend/src/components/. API functions in frontend/src/api/client.ts. React Query hooks in frontend/src/hooks/useWorkflow.ts. Types in frontend/src/types/research.ts. Backend routers in backend/app/routers/. Tailwind CSS classes used directly. lucide-react for icons. Spanish language UI.
directory_structure: Root: backend/, frontend/, docs/, docker-compose.yml. Frontend: src/components/, src/pages/, src/hooks/, src/api/, src/types/, src/__tests__/. Backend: app/routers/, app/services/, app/models/.
